Transportation analysts rarely know in advance how many genuine accident hotspots exist.

verdict.verdict_summary: DBSCAN is the mathematically and operationally superior clustering algorithm for road accident hotspot detection. Unlike KMeans, which imposes artificial spherical clusters across the entire region and forces isolated accidents into clusters, DBSCAN separates true spatial concentrations from random background noise using physically meaningful geographic distances.
verdict.limitations_note: While DBSCAN excels at identifying spatial concentrations, it does not account for variable traffic flow exposure. Neither algorithm predicts future crash causation; both provide retrospective descriptive spatial intelligence.
